<!-- pr-reviewer: 58c90960d42891901e4a48b2aa9e5f8b73cc20b3 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. I found no blocking defect.

The mask now restricts cutter centers after the model clearance erosion. The resulting centers remain inside the unmasked safe region. The tests cover open edges, wall clearance, cleared stock, and duplicate operations with stock to leave. The new test file is in the correct crate. The decision file explains the numerical policy and alternatives.

I built and tested locally after a clean trial merge with upstream main `a529c455352d8c2d228e3dd83d0e5d42a91ea9b0`. I used the separate worktree `.claude/worktrees/review-2212` and its own target directory.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed both steps in 14.2 minutes.

| Suite | Passed | Ignored | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| motion lib | 401 | 6 | 0 |
| motion: blind_floor | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: engagement_3d | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: entry_arc | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: entry_arc_3d | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: level_links | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: one_descent | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: pocket3d_hsm | 3 | 1 | 0 |
| motion: pocket3d_mask_edge | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| motion: refusal_ghost | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| app: shared_face_bodies | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| app: pocket3d_open_side | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| app: remachining | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| app: whole_model_pocket | 5 | 1 | 0 |

The last three app suites were additional local runs. `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I repeated these two mutations in the review worktree:

1. Set `MASK_RESIDUE = 0.0`. `remachining::a_redundant_duplicate_refuses_rather_than_cutting_air` failed with `a duplicate of a completed op has nothing left to cut`. I restored the code. The test passed.
2. Intersected the mask with raw `target`, instead of `center.offset(r)`. `pocket3d_mask_edge::a_redundant_duplicate_with_stock_to_leave_refuses` failed with `redundant duplicate with stock_to_leave must refuse`. I restored the code. All four `pocket3d_mask_edge` tests passed.

No G-code or CL golden changed. No UI file changed. No script, workflow, build script, or dependency changed. The review worktree has no remaining code changes.

Requested before merge: none.

Limits: I did not run the private `sc_logo.camproj` project or the release heavy lanes. The synthetic filleted-notch test passed in the default suite. The decision file records that the mask can omit real strips narrower than two lattice cells. Several existing motion unit tests took more than 60 seconds.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
